welcome.title: Welcome to HindTrucks!
welcome.content: Let's take a quick 1-minute tour of the main navigation tabs to help you get started.

navHome.title: Home Dashboard
navHome.content: Go Online to find nearby loads, view daily stats, refer friends, and view the BFC driver leaderboard.

toggle.title: Go Online / Offline
toggle.content: Toggle this switch to go online. When online, you'll immediately see high-paying loads nearby.

navLoads.title: Available Loads
navLoads.content: Browse active loads matching your truck, view route maps and payment splits, and accept new trips.

navEarnings.title: Wallet & Payouts
navEarnings.content: Track your payout histories, view wallet balance, and request instant withdrawals directly to your UPI ID.

navProfile.title: Driver Profile
navProfile.content: Verify smart card details (Licence, RC, Permits), change application languages, or log out.

bot.greeting: Hello {{name}}! I am Raahgir, your AI Driver Assistant. Tap a quick question below or type your query.
bot.welcome_greet: Hello {{name}}! I am Raahgir, your AI Driver Assistant. Raahgir found a high-paying load for you today matching your truck! From Ludhiana to Delhi, paying ₹28,500. Tap below to view details.
bot.faq_withdraw_a: Go to the Earnings tab (wallet icon in bottom bar). Tap the 'Withdraw' button, enter your UPI ID, and the money will be credited instantly!
bot.faq_accept_q: How do I accept a load?
bot.faq_accept_a: Browse the Loads tab in the bottom bar, tap on any load card to view details, and tap 'Accept Load' to start the trip.
bot.faq_bfc_a: BFC (Bharat Freight Club) is our elite network. BFC drivers get priority loads, highlighted profile badge, and higher earnings!
bot.faq_refer_a: Share your link (found on Home/Profile). When a driver joins and finishes their first trip, both of you earn ₹1,000!
bot.faq_docs_a: Go to your Profile tab to view and check your verified smart cards like Driving Licence and RC.
bot.fallback: I understand! For detailed help, you can tap one of our quick questions, or call our 24/7 Driver Support at +91 98765 43210.
